updates.geometry: Endplate modification
updates.description: A small revision to the rear wing endplate resulting in improved flow conditioning and aerodynamic characteristics across the full operating range.

updates.geometry: New floor and board
updates.description: A new floor and board featuring a modified base shape and furniture, resulting in an improvement in flow conditioning and local load generated across all conditions.

updates.geometry: Revised Front Corner Furniture
updates.description: A small modification to the front corner furniture resulting in an improvement in flow conditioning around the front tyre and resultant aerodynamic performance.

updates.geometry: Increased Brake Cooling Exit
updates.description: To meet the increased brake cooling demands of this circuit, a larger front brake cooling exit has been designed aiming at minimising the detrimental impact on aerodynamic performance.

updates.geometry: Revised Rear Corner Furniture
updates.description: An update to the rear corner furniture, featuring a revised winglet arrangement aiming at an efficient increase of aerodynamic load.

updates.geometry: Additional rear wing winglet added on centreline
updates.description: The new winglet increases local wing chord and camber increasing local downforce and drag at a ratio appropriate for Budapest L/D.

updates.geometry: Wider bodywork rear exit
updates.description: Increased exit size to achieve adequate mass flow through the sidepods to ensure we have adequate cooling for this track.

updates.geometry: Tail winglet merged into rear wing brace.
updates.description: Running the tail winglet into the rear wing brace increases local downforce and drag at a ratio appropriate for Budapest L/D.

updates.geometry: Revised pylon profiles
updates.description: By exploiting the permitted rear wing pylon geometry, the camber of the pylons has been increased to extract a little more load and maintain, even enhance the flow stability.

updates.geometry: Revised diffuser geometry
updates.description: Having observed some competitor designs, the floor diffuser geometry has gained surface area adjacent to the rear impact structure offering a local gain in load.

updates.geometry: Revised flap element geometry
updates.description: Following iterations of the rear wing design, a revised flap pairing has become available for the Hungarian GP offering more load from revised camber and chord geometries. This change is accompanied by a minor revised to the lower brace (wing) geometry as part of the new design.

updates.geometry: A new RW assembly configuration, with a change to the rear wing flap components.
updates.description: To suit the demands of the Hungaroring circuit, we have introduced an optional rear wing flap geometry which offers an increase in downforce across the rear of the car.

updates.geometry: A new Floor Bodywork configuration with the introduction of new geometry on the outboard Floor Winglet.
updates.description: A further circuit specific change, which modifies the aerodynamic loading on the outboard floor body and surrounding components at the rear corner of the car.

updates.geometry: Addition of Roll Hoop Winglets
updates.description: The roll hoop introduced at the previous event creates additional freedom in that area. These winglets improve the quality of the airflow reaching the rear of the car.

updates.geometry: Updated SM pod geometry and wing auxiliary
updates.description: A combination of changes to the SM pod and to the flaps & auxiliary components allows additional load to be generated by the rear wing, which is well suited to the circuit characteristics.

updates.geometry: Additional options of bodywork cooling louvres
updates.description: Opening the louvres on the bodywork allows more airflow through the radiators, increasing engine cooling and thus increasing the range of operating conditions.
